support_pointers: Back up from Settings Storage before replacing a portable build or reusing an existing data directory.
Use Settings Operations for JSON/CSV export, logs, and recovery checks when validating a release.
Treat release notes, package checksums, and the exact source commit as the support identity for a release.

statements.title: Windows portable package
statements.user_facing: Cabinet 1.0 is distributed as an unsigned Windows portable ZIP, not an installer.

statements.title: Voglers provider readiness
statements.user_facing: Voglers is a supported direct public storefront collector path for the Cabinet 1.0 contract.

statements.title: Hobbytech provider readiness
statements.user_facing: Hobbytech remains packaged-unproven until an exact GA candidate records the packaged provider journey.

statements.title: Frontline and Bonza provider readiness
statements.user_facing: Frontline and Bonza are preview browser-assisted paths; normal user-present browser interaction is required for protected pages and challenges.

statements.title: Assistant, Agent and Telegram readiness
statements.user_facing: Chat, Assistant, Agent and Telegram features are preview or setup-dependent and do not expand the supported collector contract.

statements.title: Data ownership, export and recovery
statements.user_facing: User data can use export, backup, and restore from local Cabinet surfaces and is not trapped behind a paid gate.
